what: Opening: in the logo slot at the center of the white curtain, a horizontal guide line is drawn from the left and a vertical guide line from the top over .95s (power2.out). The logo interior and outline form over .6s, and while the dot flashes and vanishes, the logo interior fills with the text color (sine.inOut). After .3s the white panel clears over .4s, the center circle grows 8x over 1s, and the curtain disappears over .6s, while the Hero text rises from 24px below and the header row drops in from above over .6s. With once: session it plays once per session, and afterwards only the text rises

options.[data-fx-part=box]: White panel (holds the logo SVG) — required
options.[data-fx-part=circle]: Circle that grows 8x when the panel lifts away
options.[data-fx-part=grid-h] · [data-fx-part=gr: Horizontal and vertical guide line paths inside the logo SVG
options.reveal: Element that lifts in from 24px below when the curtain opens (CSS selector)
options.head: Headline lines that descend from above when the curtain lifts (CSS selector)
options.once: If session, only once per session
options.--fx-ink: Logo fill color, default text color

from.where: index.html opening curtain (original data-opening — sessionStorage index-opening-played, grid lines .95 → logo .6 → dot → circle scale 8 1s → curtain .6 → hero y24·header line yPercent -100 .6)

note: While running, adds fx-opening-lock to html to block scrolling (the original stops Lenis). Since it makes people wait, use once: session on frequently navigated screens
